import unittest
from conftest import trace


def broken(label):
    trace(label)
    raise ValueError(label)


class SetupFailure(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.addCleanup(trace, "setup-failure-cleanup")
        broken("setUp-failure")

    def tearDown(self):
        trace("must-not-tearDown-after-failed-setUp")

    def test_body(self):
        trace("must-not-test-after-failed-setUp")


class BodyAndTeardownFailure(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.addCleanup(broken, "cleanup-failure")
        self.addCleanup(trace, "cleanup-before-failure")

    def test_body(self):
        trace("body-failure")
        self.fail("body-failure")

    def tearDown(self):
        broken("tearDown-failure")


class ClassSetupFailure(unittest.TestCase):
    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):
        cls.addClassCleanup(trace, "failed-class-setup-cleanup")
        broken("setUpClass-failure")

    @classmethod
    def tearDownClass(cls):
        trace("must-not-tearDownClass-after-failed-setup")

    def test_a(self):
        trace("must-not-class-test")

    def test_b(self):
        trace("must-not-class-test")


class ClassTeardownFailure(unittest.TestCase):
    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):
        cls.addClassCleanup(broken, "class-cleanup-first-failure")
        cls.addClassCleanup(broken, "class-cleanup-last-failure")

    @classmethod
    def tearDownClass(cls):
        broken("tearDownClass-failure")

    def test_body(self):
        trace("class-teardown-test")
